full_judgment: 29. As such, we hold that any person who was in employment but not discharged, is entitled to make such application under section 15 of Act IV of 1936 as modified, after being out of service for any reasons except being discharged as stated above. The provisions of sub-section 2 of section 15 of the Act made it clear that, not only the person in employment but anybody' so competent under section 15(2) of the Act IV of 1936 as modified, on his behalf who was in employment, can make such application within the period of limitation prescribed therein. We therefore find no substance in the submission of Mr Huq, the learned Advocate for the petitioner that an application mad by a person not in employment is not maintainable.
